critical_code_review_comments: Tab switch (tab-module1) uses window.confirm() when dirtyRef is true (StagePanel triggers dirty on load) — this can block programmatic navigation and confused testing; consider only marking dirty on real user edits, not on mount.
Module1Form: useEffect that runs prefill depends only on dossier.id — if oqlf_data updates without id change, prefill won't refresh (edge case).
